patthana12.13:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. no kilesaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.13:3.1: pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na savitakkaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na avitakkaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na savicāraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na avicāraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sappītikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na appītikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na pītisahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sukhasahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na upekkhāsahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.13:5.1: upekkhāsahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kāmāvacaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na kāmāvacaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na rūpāvacaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.13:7.1: rūpāvacaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na arūpāvacaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na
patthana12.13:8.1: arūpāvacaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na pariyāpannaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana12.13:9.1: apariyāpannaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na niyyānikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na aniyyānikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na niyataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana12.13:10.1: aniyataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na uttaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana12.13:11.1: anuttaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇe na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana12.13:12.1: na araṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na araṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na araṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu ca na araṇo na hetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana12.13:13.1: na saraṇaṃ na hetuñca na araṇaṃ na hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana12.13:14.1: hetuyā pañca, avigate pañca, (evaṃ sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.)
patthana12.13:15.1: na saraṇaṃ na na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati, hetupaccayā.
patthana12.13:16.1: na araṇaṃ na na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na na hetudhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana12.13:17.1: hetuyā dve, avigate dve, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.) na saraṇaṃ na sahetukaṃ
